title: Show the root level of your data hierarchy in the first column

statement.en: Present the root level of your data hierarchy in the first column in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況でthe root level of your data hierarchy in the first columnを表示する。

conditions: Start the macOS column view with the hierarchy’s root so people can return to the top by scrolling back.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Column views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるColumn viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Consider showing information about the selected item when there are no nested items to display

statement.ja: showing information about the selected item when there are no nested items to displayが現在の状況に適切か検討する。

conditions: The selected macOS item is a leaf with no nested children.
